basic_details.job_title: IISc Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, has invited applications for one Research Associate-I post in a time-bound research project sponsored by Grid-India (WRLDC). The post is temporary and purely contractual, for a tenure of 1 year, with consolidated emoluments of Rs. 58,000 per month + HRA as per IISc norms. A Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems or a closely related discipline is required. Applications go by email to [email protected] so as to be received by 20 December 2026, 5 pm.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application package, which should include the four items listed below.
Email the package to Dr. Soham Chakraborty at [email protected].
Write the email subject as "Position of Research Associate-I (WRLDC)".
Make sure the application is received by 20 December 2026, 5 pm.
Resume, including a list of publications.
Ph.D. degree certificate (or provisional certificate) and transcripts.
Cover letter (less than 1 page) outlining your background and reason for your interest in this position.
Names and contact details of two referees.

rows.details: Robust Stability and Performance of Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs) using Frequency-Scan Data and LMI-based Robust Control
Grid Controller of India Limited (Grid-India), Western Regional Load Despatch Centre (WRLDC)
Rs. 58,000 per month + HRA, as per IISc norms
Department of Electrical Engineering, IISc, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites interested and motivated candidates. The required qualification for Research Associate-I is: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems or a closely related discipline from a recognized university or institute. Doctoral research in control theory, with a strong background in robust control (H-infinity control, mu-analysis), optimal control and LMI-based analysis and design. Working proficiency in Python scripting. The following are desirable: Publications in reputed journals or conferences on robust or LMI-based control. Experience with the MATLAB Robust Control Toolbox and/or Python optimisation tools (e.g., CVXPY, python-control). Familiarity with inverter-based resources, power system dynamics or EMT simulation (PSCAD). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated emoluments are Rs. 58,000 per month + HRA, as per IISc norms (Circular R(HR)/IISc/Revision/2024-1153 dated 20.06.2025). The notice describes the engagement as a temporary period, purely on contractual basis, in a time-bound research project. The tenure is 1 year.

content_sections.heading: IISc Research Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will develop a robust control-theoretic framework to certify the stability and performance of grid-connected IBRs under varying grid conditions. The work includes: Small-signal state-space modelling of an IBR connected to an infinite bus from its known control structure and gains. Modelling grid-strength and topology uncertainty in the Δ−P−K framework and stating the H-infinity-based nominal/robust stability and performance (NS, NP, RS, RP) conditions. LMI formulation of these conditions through the KYP lemma, Bounded Real Lemma and Schur complement, and solving them numerically. Converting frequency-scan admittance data of black-box (vendor) IBR models into LTI state-space models for the same robustness analysis. Implementing all algorithms as Python scripts using open-source tools, benchmarked against the MATLAB Robust Control Toolbox, and validating results with EMT simulations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISc Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Prepare the application package, which should include the four items listed below. Email the package to Dr. Soham Chakraborty at [email protected] . Write the email subject as "Position of Research Associate-I (WRLDC)". Make sure the application is received by 20 December 2026, 5 pm. Resume, including a list of publications. Ph.D. degree certificate (or provisional certificate) and transcripts. Cover letter (less than 1 page) outlining your background and reason for your interest in this position. Names and contact details of two referees.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted from time to time based on their application package. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview. Selection will be based on performance in the online interview. The notice does not mention an interview date.
